## Changes since alpha.2

- Fixed a crash when an entity transforms while its final vanilla collision call is still completing. This covers piglins, hoglins, and zombies converting into drowned.
- Fixed cases where entities near the edge of the vanilla push range could fail to push each other. ECO now uses the exact vanilla search bounds and preserves vanilla candidate order.
- ECO is now always enabled while installed. The obsolete runtime enable switch has been removed.
- Added `/eco gridSize <value>` for advanced spatial-index tuning. Like `/eco vanillaOrder <true|false>`, changes take effect after restart.
- Expanded parity tests for entity transformations, repeated movement, candidate ordering, and native state ownership.

Download `entity_collision_optimizer-1.0.0-mc26.2-alpha.3.jar`. Source archives are not installable mods.
